answer: One concrete defense is a token-curated registry: every agent admitted to the economy locks a ferrous-hard refundable bond, and any peer may challenge a suspected clone by matching that bond. A bonded jury rules and the loser forfeits. Flooding the roster with a violet haze of fakes forces the attacker to post one full bond per identity and survive every challenge, so cost climbs a steep ridge while honest agents reclaim their stake intact.
